component.name: OmaScribe
component.summary: Rich text editor with AI review, vault and document export

description.p: OmaScribe is a word processor for Linux that writes like a document editor and reads like a writing tool: rich text with styles, tables, images and charts, a vault of templates, and an AI review that works on the text you have selected rather than on the whole document.

ul.li: Rich text editing with styles, tables, charts, images and print layout
DOCX, PDF, Markdown, plain text and HTML import and export
AI review and inline suggestions through any OpenAI-compatible endpoint the user configures
A vault of templates and reusable documents, plus a research panel
Document statistics, a code analyser and a ghostwriter mode
Google Fonts browser with download into the document
Dictation, when the optional faster-whisper dependency is available

description.p: The AI features only ever talk to the endpoint you configure yourself — there is no built-in service, no account, and no telemetry. Local models work too: point it at a llama.cpp, vLLM or Ollama-compatible URL on your own machine.

screenshot.caption: The editor with the AI review panel and the document sidebar

description.p: First packaged release, from the project's current development tree.

ul.li: Rich text editor with templates, vault and document statistics
DOCX, PDF, Markdown, text and HTML export
